title: I turned my RSS feeds into an e-ink newspaper to stop reading on my phone
summary: A maker created a DIY e-ink newspaper display that aggregates RSS feeds, providing a tactile, distraction-free alternative to reading news on smartphones. The project combines a small e-paper screen with a Raspberry Pi to fetch and display articles in a newspaper-style layout.
problem_solved: Reduces phone screen time and digital distraction by creating a physical, read-only newspaper device for consuming RSS content
why_valuable: Offers a creative solution to smartphone addiction by combining retro newspaper aesthetics with modern feed aggregation, promoting mindful information consumption
